purpose: Proposed structural invariants (task §13) for the future occurrence-safe structural index. Design-only; not enforced by any production code yet.

invariants.statement: No two source occurrences share nodeId within one document.
invariants.enforcement: By construction (Option D span-primary hash) + explicit collision detection at index build time (never silent overwrite).

invariants.statement: Duplicate display labels (sectionRef) are allowed and expected - not itself unhealthy.
invariants.enforcement: DUPLICATE_LABEL_EXPECTED diagnostic is informational only, never a health failure.

invariants.statement: Duplicate legal-reference candidates are allowed but represented explicitly as a set, never collapsed to one.
invariants.enforcement: findByLegalRef/resolveCitation return arrays; AmbiguityReport surfaced when length > 1.

invariants.statement: Parent-child ownership uses occurrence identity (nodeId/parentId), never label (parentSectionRef string).
invariants.enforcement: childrenByParentId keyed by nodeId, not by a re-normalized label string.

invariants.statement: No silent map overwrite - any identity-map collision at construction time is a hard-fail / health-diagnostic event.
invariants.enforcement: DUPLICATE_OCCURRENCE_ID diagnostic; construction aborts or downgrades trust for the affected document rather than silently picking a winner.

invariants.statement: No child-list merging across distinct occurrences.
invariants.enforcement: getChildren(parentNodeId) returns only children whose own parentNodeId equals the queried id - never a label match.

invariants.statement: Every indexed node is retrievable by nodeId.
invariants.enforcement: getNode(nodeId) never returns undefined for a nodeId present in allNodes().

invariants.statement: Every indexed source span belongs to the correct occurrence.
invariants.enforcement: getNodeText(nodeId, "OWN") boundary computation only consults that node's own (I6-correct) children.

invariants.statement: Traversal reaches every indexed node exactly once from its intended structural root, except explicitly orphaned/ambiguous nodes.

invariants.enforcement: orphans() API - never silently rooted or silently dropped.

invariants.statement: Cycles are impossible by construction, or explicitly detected.
invariants.enforcement: Parent identity assigned strictly top-down from already-existing ancestor ids; cycle-guard retained as a defensive check.

invariants.statement: Source spans satisfy deterministic validity checks.
invariants.enforcement: charStart < charEnd; charEnd <= documentText.length; own-span nested correctly inside parent's full span.

invariants.statement: Sibling ordering is source order (charStart ascending).
Document boundary is part of the identity domain.
invariants.enforcement: nodeId always begins with documentId in its hash input - cross-instrument collision impossible by construction, not merely by convention.

invariants.statement: Ambiguous legal references return multiple candidates rather than silently choosing one by collision.
Structural-health diagnostics surface every invariant violation as a named, queryable condition.
invariants.enforcement: healthDiagnostics() API (§13/§17 of ADR); never a silent undefined/empty result indistinguishable from legitimate absence.

criticalDesignDiscipline: DUPLICATE_LABEL_EXPECTED (I2) must never be conflated with DUPLICATE_OCCURRENCE_ID (I1/I5) - today's system conflates 'label duplicated' with 'identity broken'; the new one must not. Only the identity-level invariants (I1, I5, I6, I7) are hard failures.
